name: AR Quick View
author: arsyntax

sections.description:
AR Quick View is a lightweight and fast WooCommerce product quick view plugin that enhances the shopping experience by allowing customers to preview product details in a popup without leaving the shop page. This improves user engagement and boosts conversion rates by reducing unnecessary navigation.

Features

  1. Instant product quick view popup
  2. AJAX-based loading for a seamless experience
  3. Customizable button and popup styles
  4. Mobile-friendly and responsive design
  5. Works with all WooCommerce-compatible themes
  6. Easy to use with no coding required

Usage

After activation, go to AR Quick View Settings
Customize button styles, popup appearance, and other settings

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

= Does this plugin work with any theme? =
Yes, AR Quick View is designed to work with all WooCommerce-compatible themes.

Can I customize the Quick View button text?

Yes, you can change the button text and appearance from the settings panel.

Does it support variable products?

Yes, variable products are fully supported in the quick view popup.

Support

For any issues or feature requests, please contact us via Support Page.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in WordPress.
  2. Search for “AR Quick View”.
  3. Click “Install Now” and activate the plugin.
  4. Navigate to Appearance > Menus to start adding icons to your menu items.
